header.subject: research-looms-101
header.note: A research subject created for this run. Not the deployed fly, not a copy or continuation of it.

sensable_fields.looming: the strongest looming object, as angular size (deg), expansion rate (deg/s) and bearing (+ left, rad), or null
sensable_fields.airflowFrom: bearing the air comes from (+ left, rad), or null
sensable_fields.odour: food odour at the antennae (relative units)
sensable_fields.onFood: whether the tarsi touch food (a boolean; what food it is is dropped)

channels.form: rate = 200 Hz * min(1, sizeDeg / 40) on the side the object is on (bearing > 0: left)
channels.approximation: LPLC2 encodes angular size; the 40 deg saturation and 200 Hz ceiling are ours
cite: Klapoetke et al. 2017, Nature 551:237-241, doi:10.1038/nature24626 (LPLC2 looming selectivity)
von Reyn et al. 2017, Neuron 94:1190-1204, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2017.05.036 (LC4 angular velocity, LPLC2 angular size, into the giant fiber)
Ache et al. 2019, Curr Biol 29:1073-1081, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2019.01.079 (LPLC2 to giant fiber)

channels.form: rate = 200 Hz * min(1, expansionDegS / 400) on the object's side
channels.approximation: LC4 encodes angular velocity; the 400 deg/s saturation is ours
cite: von Reyn et al. 2017, Neuron 94:1190-1204, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2017.05.036 (LC4 angular velocity, LPLC2 angular size, into the giant fiber)
Ache et al. 2019, Curr Biol 29:1073-1081, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2019.01.079 (LPLC2 to giant fiber)

channels.form: rate = 150 Hz * min(1, airflow / 1 m/s) on both antennae
channels.approximation: JO-C/E respond to sustained antennal deflection; direction is not encoded here
cite: Yorozu et al. 2009, Nature 458:201-205, doi:10.1038/nature07843 (JO-C/E neurons sense wind)
Kamikouchi et al. 2009, Nature 458:165-171, doi:10.1038/nature07810 (JO subgroups; C/E sense static deflection)

channels.form: rate = 100 Hz * min(1, odour) on both antennae
channels.approximation: exploratory: the world's one food-odour level stands for vinegar-like odour at DM1 and VA2 ORNs
cite: Semmelhack & Wang 2009, Nature 459:218-223, doi:10.1038/nature07983 (vinegar attraction via DM1 and VA2)

channels.form: rate = 100 Hz while on food, else 0
channels.approximation: the fly tastes with its tarsi, whose GRNs project to the ventral nerve cord, outside this brain; labellar sugar GRNs stand in for them
cite: Tastekin et al. 2026, Cell, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2026.08.016 (GRN retyping and taste modalities)

feed.rule: mean MN9 rate >= 10 Hz over the window
cite: Gordon & Scott 2009, Neuron 61:373-384, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2008.12.033 (MN9, proboscis extension)

escape.rule: any giant-fiber spike in the window
cite: von Reyn et al. 2014, Nat Neurosci 17:962-970, doi:10.1038/nn.3741 (giant fiber spike selects short-mode takeoff)
